_comments: Sample configuration for CockroachDB (EXPERIMENTAL — not yet verified end-to-end).
CockroachDB is PostgreSQL-wire-compatible. Uses the standard PostgreSQL JDBC driver.
db_schema: set to the target schema (typically 'public', following PostgreSQL conventions).
If db_schema is left blank, the script defaults to the 'public' schema.
sslmode=require is recommended for CockroachDB Cloud / Serverless connections.
Download the PostgreSQL JDBC driver from https://jdbc.postgresql.org/download/
Copy to your project root, rename to orm_skyway_config.json, and edit for your database.
